options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Mayor Only
options.doc:
In Mayor only mode, you will win purely by becoming mayor with a single character.
This is an option meant for new players or short Archipelago games.
options.doc_fr:
En mode maire seulement, vous gagnerez uniquement en devenant maire avec un seul personnage.
C'est une option destinée aux nouveaux joueurs ou aux jeux d'Archipel courts.

options.name: Become Mayor
options.doc:
Requires you to become mayor at least once.
Only used if "Mayor Only" is disabled.

options.name: Big Quests Completed
options.doc:
How many big quests to compelete.
Only used if "Mayor Only" is disabled.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de grandes quêtes pour forcer.
Utilisé seulement si "Mayor Only" est désactivé.

options.name: Achievements Completed
options.doc:
How many achievements to completed.
Only used if "Mayor Only" is disabled.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de réalisations à accomplir.
Utilisé seulement si "Mayor Only" est désactivé.

options.name: Random Characters
options.doc:
How many random characters do you want to start with?
Only used if "Gorilla Mode" is disabled.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de personnages au hasard voulez-vous commencer ?
Utilisé uniquement si "Mode Gorilla" est désactivé.

options.name: Starting Characters
options.doc:
Which characters must you start with? I recommend none, but a new player may want an easier character to start with, such as Vampire or Cannibal.
These are in addition to how many random characters you picked.
If you chose 2 random characters and select Alien and Vampire, you will start with Alien and Vampire plus two random characters.
Only used if "Gorilla Mode" is disabled.

options.name: DLC Enabled
options.doc: Enabled DLC in streets of rogue. Requires DLC purchase (well worth it!)
options.doc_fr: Activer le DLC dans les rues de voyou. Nécessite un achat DLC (bien vaut ça!)
